title: Volley Envelope
description: Base envelope shared by all Volley messages. Per-channel schemas extend this with channel-specific payload constraints.

schema_version.description: Volley protocol version. v0.x only in this schema.

agent_id.description: Sender agent ID. See spec section 2.2.

parent_id.description: Parent agent ID if this agent was spawned by another Volley agent.

wall_time.description: ISO-8601 UTC timestamp with millisecond precision.

channel.description: One of the reserved channel names or a _user/* prefixed user channel.

payload.description: Channel-specific data. Shape constrained by per-channel schemas.
